alarms.action: Sets M191; sets ST10 fault M199; stops conveyor motor Y10 immediately
alarms.condition: Motor overload input X13 opens (LDI X13)
alarms.name: Motor Overload (MOL-1001)

alarms.action: Sets M190; stops conveyor motor Y10 until reset by PB-0002 (X1)
alarms.condition: Entry photo-eye PE-1002 stays blocked for more than 5.0 s while conveyor runs
alarms.name: Jam Alarm

conflicts.narrative_says: Entry photo-eye PE-1002 blocked for > 5.0 s sets jam alarm M190
conflicts.program_says: Not implemented in program (T10 and jam detection logic missing; M190 is only reset at R2)

interlocks.effect: Conveyor motor M-1001 (Y10) stops immediately via ST10 fault flag (M199)
Conveyor motor M-1001 (Y10) inhibited from running

steps.entry: Auto mode SS-0003 (X2) ON and no ST10 fault active (M199 OFF)
steps.exit: Auto mode lost, ST10 fault active (M199 ON), motor overload MOL-1001 (X13 lost), or E-stop lost
steps.name: Conveyor Running

steps.entry: Rising edge of line controller release request RQ-1005 (X14)
steps.exit: Stopper pulse timer T11 completes (2.0 s elapsed)
steps.name: Stopper Release
